title: A binding helper nested inside a 'given' param, rather than being the param, is refused at the call.
why: behavioural spec 'given': a binding helper anywhere other than as a params member's own value is refused at the call, because it would otherwise be written as a literal that only looks like a binding — the in-band ambiguity variant semantics spec §6.2 exists to prevent.

interaction.description: a binding hidden inside a literal
